name: iOS shake and accelerometer capture
prompt: Launch the motion test app on an iOS Simulator and run the motion.ios-shake task to inject one Simulator shake gesture and record a known accelerometer sample. Use the app-visible state and session evidence to verify both events.

validation.prompt: Verify the app reports Shake detected and Samples: 1, and the task named assertions passed.
assertions: The app reports Shake waiting before injection.
The app reports Shake detected after the Simulator shake.
The app reports Samples: 1 after recording a known accelerometer sample.
